notes.title: “He will guide you into all truth”
notes.intro: Jesus promises the Spirit of truth to his disciples.

views.label: The Spirit guides the Church through its tradition and teaching office
views.summary: Catholics see this promise fulfilled as the Spirit preserves the Church’s teaching through the bishops in union with the Pope.

views.label: The Spirit guides the whole Church through its councils and Tradition
views.summary: Orthodox Christians see the Spirit guiding the Church as a whole, expressed in the Ecumenical Councils and the consensus of the faithful.

views.label: The Spirit guided the apostles to write Scripture and helps believers understand it
views.summary: Protestants usually see this first as a promise to the apostles, fulfilled in the New Testament, and the Spirit illuminating Scripture for believers today.
